# FLX-3103: emit exposeId is not an expose of the referenced product

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The emit names which interface of the data product this stream fulfils. The referenced product declares no expose with that id, so there is no column set to emit against.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3103
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
